title: LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Control for Skill-Based Smart Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2610.01364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Factories are shifting toward smaller lot sizes with high product customization, requiring frequent re-programming of flexible and reconfigurable automation systems. LLM-based agents can be deployed in two complementary roles: Offline, they generate deterministic production sequences, reducing programming effort; online, they operate live machines and handle unforeseen runtime faults that static programs cannot anticipate. We propose a solution in which each factory module is paired with a dedicated LLM-based agent and an MCP tool server that exposes the module's skills via OPC UA method calls, with agents coordinating over MQTT and grounded by real-time updates of the factory state. We compare three agent architectures (orchestrator, peer-to-peer, and monolithic) across nine production challenges of increasing complexity in a simulation of a physical six-module hexagonal factory, including silent hardware fault detection. translated_title: 面向基于技能的智能制造的大语言模型驱动多智能体控制
translated_abstract: 工厂正朝着小批量、高产品定制化的方向发展，这要求对柔性可重构的自动化系统进行频繁的重新编程。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以在两种互补的角色中部署：离线状态下，它们生成确定性的生产序列，从而减少编程工作量；在线状态下，它们操控实际机器并处理静态程序无法预见的运行时故障。我们提出了一种解决方案：每个工厂模块都配有一个专用的基于LLM的智能体和一个MCP工具服务器，该服务器通过OPC UA方法调用暴露模块的技能，各智能体通过MQTT进行协调，并以工厂状态的实时更新作为决策依据。我们在一个物理六模块六边形工厂的仿真环境中，针对九个复杂度递增的生产挑战（包括隐性硬件故障检测），比较了三种智能体架构（编排者式、点对点式和单体式）的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出为每个工厂模块配备专用LLM智能体，通过MCP工具服务器、OPC UA和MQTT实现技能暴露与智能体协调，并在六边形工厂仿真中比较了编排者式、点对点式和单体式三种多智能体架构在生产任务与隐性故障检测中的表现。
